question: Which of the following ratios is the greatest?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Compare the fractions to a base value like 1/2 to quickly eliminate the smaller ratios.

37/76 and 35/72 are both less than 1/2 (as 37 × 2 258, the ratio 50 : 60 is strictly the greatest among them all.

**∴ The correct answer is 50 : 60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Four ratios: 37 : 76, 43 : 65, 35 : 72, and 50 : 60

**Method Used:**

Convert each ratio into a decimal or percentage value to easily compare their true magnitudes.

 37:76
 
 ~48.7%
 43:65
 
 ~66.2%
 35:72
 
 ~48.6%
 50:60
 
 83.3% (Greatest)
 
• 
 0%
 
• 
 50%
 
• 
 100%

**Calculations:**

⇒ 37 ÷ 76 ≈ 0.4868 or 48.68%

⇒ 43 ÷ 65 ≈ 0.6615 or 66.15%

⇒ 35 ÷ 72 ≈ 0.4861 or 48.61%

⇒ 50 ÷ 60 = 5 ÷ 6 ≈ 0.8333 or 83.33%

⇒ Comparing the evaluated fractions, 83.33% is clearly the highest decimal equivalent.

**∴ The correct answer is 50 : 60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Ratio

For two or more given ratios such as a:b and c:d, their compound ratio is formed by multiplying their respective antecedents and consequents to get ac:bd.

Duplicate & Sub-duplicate Ratio

The duplicate ratio of a:b is calculated as a²:b², while its sub-duplicate ratio is evaluated as √a:√b.

Proportion Rule

When two respective ratios are exactly equal (a/b = c/d), they form a valid proportion where the product of the extremes directly equals the product of the means (ad = bc).
